description: This file defines a validation rule class 'BuzzVideoLinkValidationRule' for validating Buzz video URLs within the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract validation rule and uses a DTO class 'BuzzEmbeddedURL' to perform URL validation.

classes.name: BuzzVideoLinkValidationRule
classes.description: A validation rule class to check the validity of Buzz video URLs, extending the abstract rule framework.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the input URL by instantiating BuzzEmbeddedURL and calling its isValidURL method.
